description: Illustrative minimal §0.43 enforcer-scope registry — one domain-spanning enforcer declaring its full domain_root plus the required scope markers and forbidden narrowings the no-blind-spots meta-gate checks against its source. Public-safe: the illustrated enforcer scans the public tree only.

enforcers.concept: mechanism-keyword leakage into any public surface (Hard rule #1 / §33)
enforcers.notes: public carries 8 surfaces (site/admin/app/dev/sandbox/status/oss/widgets) plus content libraries. The patent-safety concept spans the WHOLE public tree, so the scan must walk it end-to-end. Narrowing the walk to just one surface would blind it to a leak in the others — the exact §0.43 under-scoping class.
